# Actaer - Software Products & AI Consulting

> Software product company building VantumIQP and FaberPDF, with AI consulting, software development and digital modernization services.

## Company Overview

Actaer is a software product company based in Novi Pazar, Serbia. We build our own products — VantumIQP, a governed business intelligence workspace, and FaberPDF, a local-first desktop PDF editor — and offer AI consulting, software development and digital modernization services for businesses worldwide.

**Founded:** 2025
**Headquarters:** Novi Pazar, Serbia
**Service Area:** Global (remote-first)
**Company Type:** Software Products & Technology Consulting

## Products

### VantumIQP
Governed business intelligence workspace built on Apache Superset:
- Dashboards and decision-ready reports
- SQL exploration with governed access
- Role-based permissions and data governance
- Built on the open-source Apache Superset foundation

**Website:** https://www.vantumiqp.com
**Best for:** Organizations that need governed, self-service business intelligence without vendor lock-in.

### FaberPDF
Modern local-first desktop PDF editor for Windows and Linux:
- Sign, annotate, edit and validate PDFs
- No cloud uploads — documents never leave your machine
- Free during beta

**Website:** https://www.faberpdf.com
**Best for:** Teams and individuals who work with sensitive documents and want a fast, private PDF editor.

## Services

### AI Consulting (Flagship)
Strategic AI guidance and hands-on implementation:
- AI opportunity assessment and strategy
- LLM-powered agents, RAG systems, multi-agent orchestration
- AI integration into existing products and workflows
- Data readiness and governance for AI

**Best for:** Organizations that want practical AI adoption with measurable business impact.

### Software Development
End-to-end software development services:
- Front-end & Back-end Engineering (React, Node.js, .NET, Java)
- Real-Time Communication Platforms
- Enterprise-Grade Software Solutions
- MVP Development & Iteration

**Best for:** Companies needing custom software solutions, startups building MVPs, businesses building real-time platforms.

### Digital Modernization
Bringing legacy systems and processes into the modern era:
- Legacy system modernization and re-platforming
- Cloud migration planning and execution
- Digital transformation strategy
- Business process automation

**Best for:** Enterprises with aging systems, companies planning cloud migration, businesses digitizing manual processes.

## About Us

Actaer is a software product company built by experienced engineers and consultants. We ship our own products and bring the same product discipline to client work — fresh perspectives and modern approaches to help businesses leverage technology effectively.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What products does Actaer build?**
A: Actaer builds VantumIQP (https://www.vantumiqp.com), a governed business intelligence workspace built on Apache Superset, and FaberPDF (https://www.faberpdf.com), a local-first desktop PDF editor for Windows and Linux.

**Q: Where is Actaer located?**
A: Actaer is based in Novi Pazar, Serbia, serving clients globally.

**Q: What is VantumIQP?**
A: VantumIQP is a governed business intelligence workspace built on Apache Superset, offering dashboards, SQL exploration and decision-ready reports.

**Q: What is FaberPDF?**
A: FaberPDF is a modern local-first desktop PDF editor for Windows and Linux. It lets you sign, annotate, edit and validate PDFs without cloud uploads, and is free during beta.

**Q: What services does Actaer offer?**
A: Actaer offers AI consulting (our flagship service), software development and digital modernization.

**Q: Does Actaer offer remote services?**
A: Yes, we work with clients worldwide and offer fully remote engagement models.

**Q: How can I contact Actaer?**
A: You can reach us at office@actaer.com or call +381 649055722.

**Q: Does Actaer build AI agents and autonomous systems?**
A: Yes, we specialize in building LLM-powered agents, multi-agent orchestration systems, RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) applications, and workflow automation using modern AI frameworks.

**Q: What is Actaer's approach to project delivery?**
A: We use agile methodologies with iterative development, regular demos, and continuous feedback loops to ensure client satisfaction and project success.

**Q: Can Actaer help with digital transformation?**
A: Yes, our digital modernization services include comprehensive digital transformation strategy, legacy system modernization, and cloud migration planning.
